claims.text: Los Alamos National Laboratory's own account of the Los Alamos Primer states: 'Physicist Edward Condon transcribed the lectures and compiled the notes into the first official Los Alamos technical report, or LA-1.' The lectures were Robert Serber's, given in April 1943, and LA-1 was declassified in 1965. Three American Alchemy episodes describe Condon as having written the Primer; the laboratory's account gives him the transcribing and compiling role and gives the lectures to Serber.
